_about: Strings for the launch page's section 'Model accuracy has improved over time' (site: src/lib/who-wrote-this/Timeline.svelte, which imports a byte-identical copy at src/lib/who-wrote-this/timeline.json). Copied from content.json's timeline object on 16 Nov 2026 and reworked for the guided scroll: closed-weights line traces, open-weights line traces, then both lines are named on the picture, then the trained detectors. content.json is unchanged (the hero still reads timeline.steps from it). Paper text is {t, src}; every string that is not paper text is in `ui`. Numbers on the picture come from timeline_rq1.json (built by docs/launch_20261116/tools/build_timeline_data.py from paper/figures/data/rq1_points.json, Figure 2's 860-document sample), never from this file.

title.t: Model accuracy has improved over time.

steps.t: Accuracy on both labels climbed from 27% for GPT-4o in 2024 and 59% for GPT-5.2 in 2025 to 91% for present-day frontier models.
The best open-weight models still trail, with Kimi K3.1 Pro reaching 63%.
Closed-weight models (solid purple) consistently outperform open-weight models (dashed pink).
Frontier models are competitive with trained detectors such as Pangram 4 at prose detection.
On idea detection, they exceed the accuracy of IdeaLens, the only existing state-of-the-art idea detector.

caption.t: Lines step up at each new best model.
